neighbours.label: Old-World setting (Indian food, camel caravans and steppe nomads, ancient Egypt, Scythians / Sarmatians): fires at the word where the setting calls for an Old-World noun or ethnonym; the American counterpart of the same sentence is quiet. Other side of the - pole, which predicts ' New' (New England); this pole's output suppresses ' New'
